text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was time for training,
but Gold Ship was nowhere to be found.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As I walked along the beach searching for her—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, step right up!!
Welcome, welcome!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Freshly made yakisoba right here~!!
With sweet and savory rich sauce~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For some reason, Gold Ship was selling yakisoba at a beach hut...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not knowing the circumstances,
I try to call out to them anyway, but—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me.
Could I get one order of yakisoba, please?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Sure thin—
...Wait, Flash?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one who appeared was Eishin Flash,
a serious and methodical German-born Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Surprising. Out of all the noodles out there, I never expected you to eat yakisoba—the absolute junk of junks.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I totally thought you'd be making your own
pentagon-chart-perfect, nutritionally balanced bento.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Everyone around me suggested that
I should enjoy summer to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Following everyone's lead, I thought I would first try tasting some yakisoba.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh, now that's a great attitude!
In that case, I'll give ya a special super discount!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Here ya go! One sweet-and-savory yakisoba, extra fried batter bits,
and an explosive heap of spicy cod roe mayo, order up!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
J-Just looking at it, I can tell it's a massive bomb of calories...!
So this is midsummer yakisoba...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, take one bite and you'll be hooked.
Just try it for now!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I shall partake with all my heart...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I waited for Eishin Flash to leave
before trying to speak up. But just then—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Excuse meee,
one yakisoba, please~.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Welcome, how would you like your red pickled ginger—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, oh, it's just you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next to appear was Tosen Jordan.
A gal Umamusume with a laid-back vibe.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... That's my line.
Why are you the one minding the store?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Because my soul is one with yakisoba,
and I'm thinking about yakisoba at all times."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So, your order was no cabbage,
no sauce, extra extra noodles, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I haven't even said anything yet!
...For now, just the regular one.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, it's done!!
Super-spicy Diabolo Yakisoba,
overflowing with habaneros and chili peppers, suckers!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Th-This isn't ordinary at all!!
It looks waaaay too spicy, though!?!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Daaah-ha-ha!! As far as I'm concerned,
that's my normal style!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Come on, eat up!
Or are ya too chicken to try it?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Then I wouldn't mind eating it
for you, y'know~~? What're ya gonna do!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Urgh, so annoying~~~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I can totally eat this if I try!!
Fine, I just have to eat it, right?! I'll eat it!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, if you can finish it all, you get
shaved ice for dessert! If you can finish it all, that is!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Daaahahaha! What kind of face
is that punk gonna make eating it? Just thinking about it gets me hyped♪

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: And the next customer is—ooh.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well if it ain't Trainer.
You wanna go for ultra-spicy too?
choice_data_list: No, I was thinking we should do some training.
No, I was just thinking of getting some training in.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Huuuh? What're you babbling about on such a perfect day for yakisoba?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but nothin' in the world is gonna budge me today!
I'm sellin' this yakisoba no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True to her word, Gold Ship kept selling
yakisoba until the sun went down.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whew, what a sale.
Totally sold out!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: This oughta fix the old shopkeeper's back pain right up by tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It turns out she was helping out at the shop
because the owner had thrown out his back.
choice_data_list: All sorts of different guests showed up, huh?
All sorts of different guests came by, didn't they?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yakisoba is a historic junk food
beloved by people of all ages, after all.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Wonder if Flash and Jordan ended up eating every last bite too? Heheh!
choice_data_list: Are you close with those two?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Golshi-chan is a super friendly dude
loved by everyone in the whole wide world!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Though well, if I had to say anything, Flash is just a super nice gal.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: She's crazy diligent, taking notes on all the homework deadlines and test dates to tell me about 'em.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Well, even if you teach me, I'll probably just forget right away.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Also, that Jordan...
she's got this kinda... aggressive attitude, y'know?
choice_data_list: Are you trying to act tough?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
How do I put it, you know?
Like, 'I wonder how she'd react if I flicked her forehead~♪ Ooh, the thrill!' kinda vibe.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: The naughty little boy inside me just keeps whispering, 'Go on, do it.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "It doesn't quite click with me, but in her own way, she must be fond of the two of them."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "Man, summer vacation's almost over, huh."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Next time I run into Jordan,
I wanna pull off another sick prank on her...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey Trainer, got any ideas
for a nice summer-like way to hang out?
choice_data_list: We could do watermelon splitting together or something.
How about doing a long-distance swim together or something?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: A summer tradition—watermelon splitting, huh—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The green fruit splits open, red juice bursts forth,
and black seeds dance through the air...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: The key to winning is controlling your strength so you don't crush it to dust.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Hell yeah!
I'll show 'em my exquisite bat control skills, babyyy!!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Long-distance swimming?
I get it... You mean deep-sea fishing, right?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Being jolted around for long periods builds up your lower body, and above all, it builds grit.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Even Jordan's chill way of talking might turn entirely into formal kanji one of these days.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Hell yeah! Next time I see that guy,
I'm shippin' him off on a tuna boat!!"
